problem: Extraction traced the fitted central curve through the confidence band but missed the discrete Bulge/Disk marker series (squares, diamonds, large circle).
suggested_fix: Detect and extract filled discrete markers as their own series rather than only digitizing the smooth fitted curve.

problem: Data points are correct but the x-axis was labeled with the title of an adjacent stacked panel (MINERVA-1092611) instead of the real axis label.
suggested_fix: Restrict axis-label text search to the current panel's bounding box so labels from neighboring stacked panels are not picked up.

problem: Legend lists 5 nearly-coincident dashed curves but only 3 series were reconstructed, plus a couple stray y=0 points past x=0.5.
suggested_fix: Separate heavily overlapping dashed curves by color and suppress flat baseline points beyond the data extent.

problem: Original is a residual/spectrum panel with linear x in 32.350-32.365, but reconstruction uses a log x-axis spanning 10^1-10^2, a nonsensical range.
suggested_fix: Fix axis-type and tick-value detection so a linear narrow-range x-axis is not misread as decade-spanning log.

problem: Red Gaussian fit peak was captured well but the x tick labels render as overlapping garbled log-formatted values.
suggested_fix: Correct tick-label parsing for the dense numeric x-axis so reconstructed x values and labels are legible and linear.

problem: The gray noisy spectrum was digitized as a dense green scatter of points, producing garbage rather than a discrete data series.
suggested_fix: Detect spectrum/histogram step traces and avoid emitting every noisy pixel as a marker point.

problem: The red double-peaked fit curve was captured but split into two color series with a few stray y=0 edge points.
suggested_fix: Merge same-curve points into one series and drop baseline points outside the fit's x-extent.

problem: The red fit peak is captured (orange) but is swamped by a dense blue scatter digitized from the gray noise spectrum, plus garbled log x labels.
suggested_fix: Suppress spectrum-noise pixels and keep only the fitted-curve series; fix x-axis label parsing.

problem: Six legend curves (1.13-0.07 ML) but only five peaks were reconstructed and the top curve's legend label is misaligned.
suggested_fix: Recover the missing top series and align legend colors/labels to the correct curves.

problem: The two decay curves are captured well but an orange series traces a spurious vertical step artifact dropping to y=0 near x=3.
suggested_fix: Filter out the near-vertical edge artifact so only the genuine decay curves remain.

problem: Only the H atoms curve and fmol markers were extracted; the HI (black) and H2 (pink) filled series in the legend are missing.
suggested_fix: Extract the filled/area HI and H2 curves in addition to the dashed H-atoms line.

problem: Same chart family: HI and H2 series from the legend are not reconstructed, only H atoms and fmol.
suggested_fix: Extract the filled HI and H2 area series alongside the dashed line and markers.

problem: The rising z=5..12 curve family is captured well but an extra unlabeled 'D' series and low-y scatter around x=10 add noise.
suggested_fix: Suppress the spurious bottom scatter and drop the empty 'D' series so only the five z curves remain.

problem: Original is a stacked/filled multi-component spectrum but only the top total envelope was extracted as one series.
suggested_fix: Either extract the individual stacked components or explicitly label the single output as the total envelope.

problem: Dense overlapping GRB-SNe light curves are mostly captured but series identity is uncertain and the green/red series are sparsely sampled.
suggested_fix: Improve color separation of overlapping light-curve series so each band is sampled consistently.

problem: The multi-curve decay-chain family is captured on log-y but only one series is labeled 'Th' while the rest are unlabeled.
suggested_fix: Associate inline curve annotations (d=260, n, nu, Th) with each series so all curves get labels.

problem: Three decay curves (SHM, LMC pres., LMC peri.) are captured correctly but only SHM is labeled.
suggested_fix: Map the inline text annotations LMC (pres.) and LMC (peri.) to their respective curves.

problem: The declining luminosity-function series and fit lines are captured but legend labels are garbled placeholders ('s','s','D').
suggested_fix: Fix legend-entry text parsing so the FRESCO/COSMOS-3D/EIGER labels are read instead of single-character fragments.

problem: Original is a 2D hexbin/colormap heatmap (DALI vs XH); extraction emitted every hex-cell center as a multicolored grid of points.
suggested_fix: Detect hexbin/heatmap density plots and skip them rather than digitizing cell centers as a scatter series.

problem: Hexbin heatmap (DALI vs SEDflx) was misread as a regular grid of colored scatter points.
suggested_fix: Add hexbin/heatmap detection to reject density-map panels before marker extraction.

problem: Continuous 2D color-density map was extracted as a meaningless grid of dots.
suggested_fix: Recognize smooth/hex colormap fills and skip them instead of sampling a point grid.

problem: Hexbin heatmap (GIOTTO vs SEOB) misread as a scatter of colored grid points.
suggested_fix: Detect and reject hexbin/heatmap panels prior to marker extraction.
